# SB-1010 Safety bulletin: noise exposure

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01

Hazard description
Excessive noise exposure from machining and shot blast operations on EQ-P3-L3-SB01 can cause temporary or permanent hearing damage and contributes to worker fatigue and communication errors. Primary noise sources are the blast cabinet cycle and downstream material handling. Intermittent high-level impulses during loading and misalignment events increase peak exposure risk. Employees working at or near EQ-P3-L3-SB01 without appropriate controls are at elevated risk during standard operation and during maintenance activities where enclosures may be open or mitigations are bypassed.

Affected equipment
This bulletin applies to EQ-P3-L3-SB01: Machining shot blast cabinet #1 and all portable support tools directly associated with its operation. Refer to maintenance record MM-P3-L3-SB01 for historical noise measurements and to SOP-P3-L3-02 and SOP-P3-L3-05 for operating and maintenance task boundaries that define personnel access and lockout conditions. Lubricant for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) is CFW-LUB-709.

Required controls
- Administrative controls: limit time in the immediate work zone in accordance with SOP-P3-L3-02 and ensure work-rest rotation when tasks require proximity to EQ-P3-L3-SB01. Post hazard signage at defined access points per SOP-P3-L3-05.
- Engineering controls: maintain and verify acoustic enclosures and seals during scheduled maintenance; repair or replace damaged dampening components immediately. Validate cabinet alignment and material containment to reduce impulse events; record actions in MM-P3-L3-SB01.
- PPE: require hearing protection for all personnel entering the defined hazard zone. Train personnel on correct selection and fit per SOP-P3-L3-02.
- Maintenance controls: while servicing, ensure energy isolation and enclosure restoration before re-entry; document lubricant use CFW-LUB-709 in maintenance logs linked to MM-P3-L3-SB01.

Effective date
This bulletin is effective on issuance and supersedes prior informal guidance for EQ-P3-L3-SB01. Review references MM-P3-L3-SB01, SOP-P3-L3-02, SOP-P3-L3-05 for implementation details.
